statusDetail: The requested URL redirects to https://telegram.org/. Audit covers the destination public-site templates. Atomic coverage complete: 58/58 checks judged.

page.notes: t.me redirects to telegram.org. Representative public information, download, safety, FAQ, and developer API templates were audited.

checkOutcomes.reason: No scroll-linked animation exists on the representative pages, so there is no implementation to place on a scroll timeline.

checkOutcomes.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found ordinary links and native scrolling, with no custom pointermove, swipe, pull-to-refresh, or gesture interception fighting platform behaviour.
Long FAQ (about 53,068px mobile content height) and Safety pages retain static header chrome with no progress, shrinking, or scroll-state response.

checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip, popover, or floating menu is exposed on the audited public pages.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Screenshots show an active blue underline in the global navigation; FAQ in-page links use real fragment targets, preserving location and orientation.
Desktop and mobile load screenshots show content immediately with no modal, consent wall, interstitial, or obscuring banner.

checkOutcomes.reason: No overlay, modal flow, disclosure widget, or rich picker is present on these static public pages.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Across home, FAQ, Apps, Safety, and API screenshots, a single compact header leaves the viewport primarily to content.
At a requested 360px viewport, Safety reports a 450px layout viewport and 90px horizontal overflow, forcing browser scale-down rather than true 360px reflow.
Mobile and desktop screenshots show the reused global header and content columns adapting via responsive CSS; no component is reused in conflicting container sizes that requires a container query.
Lighthouse target-size passed, viewport scaling is allowed, the theme button retains a browser focus outline, and primary header links occupy the 48px header hit area.
The first viewport names Telegram, presents platform download choices, and uses direct labels such as “Telegram for Android” and “Telegram for iPhone / iPad”.
The home and Apps paths expose direct platform-specific download links without account walls, modals, or hidden prerequisites.
The static download and documentation journeys use normal links and browser history, with no loading shell or partial state on the exercised successful paths.

Cross-template metadata, language, HTTP status, robots, sitemap, and canonical checks. Blog/article details, authenticated web apps, checkout, account flows, and native apps were not covered because they are distinct products or absent from this public site.

findings.summary: Add system-driven dark mode
findings.evidence: Dark emulation matches true, but home-dark.png is visually identical to the light capture; computed body remains rgb(255,255,255) and color-scheme is normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme: light dark and retint surfaces with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Stop decorative logo motion when reduced motion is requested
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, getAnimations() still reports the non-essential 500ms t-logo-play animation.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap decorative animation in no-preference and disable it under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Adapt to higher contrast and fix low-contrast links
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast: more screenshot is unchanged, while axe measures the main #0088cc links at only 3.89:1 on white.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a darker link token meeting 4.5:1 and add prefers-contrast/forced-colors adjustments.

findings.summary: Route changes swap abruptly
findings.evidence: The navigation video records a direct cross-document swap from Home to FAQ; DOM/CSS has no view-transition declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } and stable view-transition names, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Long documents provide no scroll-state guidance
findings.evidence: Long FAQ (about 53,068px mobile content height) and Safety pages retain static header chrome with no progress, shrinking, or scroll-state response.
findings.suggestedFix: Add lightweight CSS scroll-state/progress feedback on long FAQ and Safety documents.

findings.summary: Safety uses a 450px minimum layout on a 360px device
findings.evidence: At a requested 360px viewport, Safety reports a 450px layout viewport and 90px horizontal overflow, forcing browser scale-down rather than true 360px reflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the 450px minimum constraint and let charts/content reflow within 100% inline size at 360px.

findings.summary: Cold-load LCP is 4.7 seconds
findings.evidence: Cold Lighthouse reports LCP 4.7s (score 0.33), outside the good <=2.5s Core Web Vitals threshold, although CLS is 0.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the actual LCP asset, remove the redirect for canonical traffic, and defer below-fold images/media.

findings.summary: A 194ms main-thread task blocks initial responsiveness
findings.evidence: The DevTools trace records one 194.12ms main-thread task and 144.12ms total blocking time on the simple landing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the long task, split non-critical startup work, and defer demo/sticker setup until needed.

findings.summary: Blocking resources and unused CSS delay a simple page
findings.evidence: HAR confirms three parser-inserted render-blocking stylesheets and three classic scripts without async/defer; Lighthouse also estimates 26 KiB unused CSS and cold LCP is 4.7s.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, defer classic scripts, and remove the 26 KiB of unused CSS reported by Lighthouse.

findings.guidanceCategory: Give meaningful images concise alt text (or alt="" when decorative) and name the logo link “Telegram home”.
findings.summary: Images and the logo link lack accessible alternatives
findings.evidence: axe reports two images without alt text, the logo home link without an accessible name, and the Images primitive confirms two missing alt attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: small

findings.guidanceCategory: Darken the link color so normal text reaches at least 4.5:1 in every state.
findings.summary: Shared blue links fail WCAG AA contrast
findings.evidence: axe reports serious color-contrast failures: the shared #0088cc link color is 3.89:1 on white across navigation and news links.
findings.suggestedFix: small

findings.guidanceCategory: Use semantic header/nav/main/footer landmarks, one descriptive H1, and sequential heading levels.
findings.summary: Home lacks basic heading and landmark structure
findings.evidence: axe reports no main landmark, no H1 on Home, invalid heading order, broad content outside landmarks, and an empty heading.
findings.suggestedFix: medium

findings.guidanceCategory: Set width and height or aspect-ratio on each image to make sizing explicit.
findings.summary: Below-fold images omit intrinsic dimensions
findings.evidence: Images primitive reports both sampled below-fold news images omit width and height attributes (and loading/srcset).
findings.suggestedFix: small

findings.guidanceCategory: Add a unique concise meta description matching each page purpose.
findings.summary: Every sampled page lacks a meta description
findings.evidence: Metadata probe finds a descriptive title but no meta description on Home, FAQ, Apps, Safety, or API; Lighthouse meta-description fails.
findings.suggestedFix: small

findings.guidanceCategory: Return real 404 status for unknown URLs, publish robots.txt and sitemap.xml, and add canonical links.
findings.summary: Soft 404s and missing canonical crawl signals confuse indexing
findings.evidence: robots.txt and sitemap.xml return 404, sampled pages have no canonical, and an invented URL returns HTTP 200 with the homepage, creating a soft-404 indexing signal.
findings.suggestedFix: medium

findings.guidanceCategory: Deploy a restrictive Content-Security-Policy and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, testing CSP in report-only first.
findings.summary: Core XSS and MIME-sniffing defenses are absent
findings.evidence: Headers primitive finds HTTPS and HSTS, but no Content-Security-Policy and no X-Content-Type-Options; the short-lived cookie is Secure and HttpOnly.
findings.suggestedFix: medium

findings.guidanceCategory: Set a suitable Referrer-Policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.
findings.summary: Privacy-oriented browser policies are incomplete
findings.evidence: Headers primitive finds no Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy; X-Frame-Options and HSTS are present.
findings.suggestedFix: small

findings.summary: Unknown routes silently become the homepage
findings.evidence: A clearly nonexistent path returns HTTP 200 and silently renders the homepage instead of an explicit not-found state with recovery guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a clear 404 page with navigation, search/help, and a route back to the intended task.

findings.summary: Localized pages omit language and direction metadata
findings.evidence: All five sampled documents omit html lang (axe serious), and the root computed direction metadata is also undeclared despite offering 19 languages.
findings.suggestedFix: Set html lang for every selected locale and dir="rtl" for Arabic/Persian output; favour logical CSS properties.

findings.summary: Below-fold images are heavy and not responsive or lazy
findings.evidence: HAR transfers 666,179 image bytes; the two 600px news images lack lazy loading and srcset, including one 324,389-byte below-fold image.
findings.suggestedFix: Add loading="lazy", width/height, and responsive srcset/sizes; compress the 324 KB news image further.

findings.summary: Demo media starts loading before user intent
findings.evidence: The simple landing page initiates six media requests plus 20 image requests and transfers 798,160 bytes before interaction; demo MP4 requests begin without user intent.
findings.suggestedFix: Use preload="none" for demo videos and fetch/play them only on explicit interaction or when near the viewport.

taskList.title: Repair the shared accessibility foundation: landmarks and headings, accessible names and alt text, and AA link contrast.
Make the Safety template genuinely reflow at 360px instead of scaling a 450px layout.
Deploy CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.
Fix crawl signals: real 404 responses, canonical links, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and per-page descriptions.
Improve cold LCP and startup efficiency by deferring media and scripts, trimming CSS, and optimising below-fold images.
Respect dark, reduced-motion, and higher-contrast user preferences.
Declare the selected language and writing direction on every localized page.
Add scroll-state orientation on long documents and smooth cross-document navigation.
Give below-fold images intrinsic width and height.
